ms365.description: An MCP server that manages Microsoft 365 account authentication and enables chat messaging operations within the suite.
ms365.llm_summary: This MCP server provides comprehensive Microsoft 365 management, handling authentication and enabling automated operations across the suite's core applications like Outlook, Excel, OneDrive, and Planner. It is ideally suited for automating routine office tasks, such as scheduling meetings, managing communications, organizing files, and creating structured content. Key capabilities include creating and deleting calendar events and emails, generating Excel charts and formatted ranges, managing OneNote pages and OneDrive files, and orchestrating tasks in Planner and To Do.

nixos.description: This server provides tools for searching and retrieving information about NixOS packages, system options, and channels, as well as configuration options for Home Manager and nix-darwin. odinfun-mcp.description: An MCP server that enables BTC-backed token management including buying, selling, and balance checks on the Internet Computer.
odinfun-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server enables comprehensive management of Bitcoin-backed tokens on the Internet Computer blockchain, allowing users to create, trade, and provide liquidity for these assets. It is ideally suited for DeFi activities like token swapping, market making, and portfolio management directly within the Internet Computer ecosystem. Key capabilities include creating new tokens, executing buys and sells with either BTC or token amounts, checking balances, managing liquidity pools, and accessing market data like token lists and current BTC pricing.

ohcard.description: An MCP server that facilitates OH card readings by drawing cards, guiding interpretations, and providing reflective questions.
ohcard.llm_summary: This server enables interactive OH card readings, a projective psychological tool used for self-reflection and insight. It is best suited for personal exploration, therapeutic contexts, or creative brainstorming sessions where visual prompts can stimulate discussion. Its key capabilities include drawing random OH cards, providing interpretation guidance tailored to the drawn image, and generating reflective questions to deepen the user's analysis of the card's symbolism.

octagon.description: An MCP server that conducts deep research and web scraping using specialized agents for comprehensive data extraction and analysis.
octagon.llm_summary: The Octagon MCP server specializes in comprehensive data gathering and analysis by deploying specialized agents for deep research and web scraping. It is ideally suited for tasks requiring thorough investigation, such as competitive analysis, academic research, or compiling detailed reports from diverse online sources. Its key capabilities include executing targeted research queries, performing in-depth exploratory analysis on complex topics, and programmatically extracting structured data from websites through its dedicated scraper, crawler, and research agents.

octagon-agent.description: Analyzes financial documents like 10-K filings to extract financial metrics and risk factors.
octagon-agent.output_type: extracted financial metrics and risk factors

prompt.description: A query specifying the financial document analysis task and required outputs.

ns-server.description: An MCP server that provides real-time travel information including departures, arrivals, disruptions, and pricing for NS train services in the Netherlands.
ns-server.llm_summary: This MCP server provides real-time Dutch railway data, specializing in NS train services across the Netherlands to assist with trip planning and monitoring. It is ideally suited for travelers, commuters, and logistics planning, offering tools to check schedules, disruptions, and rental bike availability at stations. Key capabilities include fetching live departures and arrivals, checking fares, receiving travel advice for specific routes, and getting alerts for service disruptions.

openapi explorer.description: This server helps users explore and understand OpenAPI specifications by providing an overview of an API and detailed information about its specific operations.
openapi explorer.llm_summary: This server enables exploration and analysis of OpenAPI specification files, providing a structured way to understand API capabilities and endpoints. It is ideally suited for developers integrating with new APIs, technical writers documenting services, or architects reviewing API designs. Its core capabilities include generating a high-level summary of an entire API's structure and retrieving granular details about specific API operations, such as parameters, request formats, and response schemas.

ollama.description: An MCP server that interacts with local LLMs by listing, showing, and querying models via the Ollama framework.
ollama.llm_summary: This server connects to the Ollama framework to manage and interact with locally running large language models. It is ideally suited for developers and users who need to experiment with, compare, or utilize different open-source LLMs directly from their local environment without relying on external APIs. Its key capabilities include querying any available local model with the `ask_model` tool, retrieving a list of installed models via `list_models`, and obtaining detailed configuration information for a specific model using `show_model`.

ask_model.description: Asks a specified model a question and returns the response.

model.description: The name of the model to query.

question.description: The question to ask the model.

list_models.description: Lists all available models on the server.

show_model.description: Displays detailed information about a specific model.

name.description: The name of the model to display information for.

ollama mcp server.description: A bridge that integrates Ollama's local LLM capabilities into MCP-powered applications, enabling users to run, manage, and interact with AI models locally with full control and privacy.
ollama mcp server.llm_summary: This server connects MCP applications to Ollama, allowing users to leverage locally-run large language models for tasks that require privacy, data control, and offline operation. It is ideally suited for developers and researchers who need to experiment with, manage, and integrate various open-source models directly within their local environment without relying on external APIs. Its key capabilities include generating chat completions, executing and managing models (run, list, rm), and handling the full model lifecycle—from pulling and creating models to copying, inspecting (show), and sharing them via push.

open-streetmap-mcp.description: An OpenStreetMap MCP server implementation that enhances LLM capabilities with location-based services and geospatial data.
open-streetmap-mcp.llm_summary: This server provides geospatial data and location-based services by leveraging OpenStreetMap, enabling LLMs to access and analyze real-world geographic information. It excels at tasks involving navigation, local exploration, and urban planning, such as finding routes, assessing neighborhoods, or locating specific facilities like schools or EV charging stations. Key capabilities include address geocoding and reverse geocoding, finding nearby places by category, calculating route directions, and identifying practical local amenities like parking or optimal meeting points.

connector_types.description: List of connector types to filter charging stations (e.g., type2, ccs).

min_power.description: Minimum power output in kilowatts for the charging stations.

find_nearby_places.description: Finds nearby places of interest within a specified radius around a given location, filtered by categories and a result limit.
find_nearby_places.input_type: location coordinates, radius, categories, result limit

radius.description: Radius in meters around the location to search for places.

categories.description: List of categories to filter places (e.g., amenity, shop, tourism).

parking_type.description: Type of parking facility to filter results (e.g., surface, underground).

It is ideally suited for multimodal tasks such as interpreting images, processing audio files, and conducting chats that combine text with one or more images. Its key capabilities include generating chat completions, performing in-depth analysis on individual or multiple images, analyzing audio, and providing tools to search and validate available models within the OpenRouter ecosystem.

openspec mcp.description: Enables spec-driven development with task tracking, approval workflows, and real-time progress monitoring through OpenSpec CLI functionality. Includes a web dashboard for visual management of change proposals and specifications.
openspec mcp.llm_summary: This server facilitates structured development by managing specifications, change proposals, and their associated workflows through the OpenSpec CLI. It is ideally suited for teams implementing spec-driven development, tracking tasks, and managing formal approval processes for changes and proposals. Its key capabilities include creating and archiving changes, generating proposals, batch-updating tasks, checking approval readiness, and providing real-time progress summaries and visual dashboards for oversight.

opensubtitles mcp server.description: Enables searching and downloading subtitles from OpenSubtitles.com through their API. Supports comprehensive search by movie title, IMDB/TMDB ID, file hash, and TV show episodes with multiple subtitle formats (SRT, ASS, VTT).

It excels at media-related tasks like localizing video content, improving accessibility, and syncing subtitles with media files. Key capabilities include searching by multiple criteria (title, IMDB/TMDB ID, file hash, or episode details), calculating file hashes for precise matching, and downloading subtitles in various formats including SRT, ASS, and VTT.

okx exchange.description: This server provides real-time price data and historical candlestick chart information for trading instruments on the OKX cryptocurrency exchange.
okx exchange.llm_summary: This server delivers real-time and historical market data from the OKX cryptocurrency exchange, enabling users to monitor live prices and analyze price trends. It is best suited for trading analysis, market research, and developing trading strategies that require up-to-date exchange information. Its key capabilities include fetching the latest spot price for any trading pair and retrieving historical candlestick data for technical analysis over specified timeframes.

opgg-mcp.description: An MCP server that provides League of Legends champion stats, player profiles, match history, and meta insights through OP.GG data.
opgg-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server provides comprehensive League of Legends and Teamfight Tactics (TFT) data by interfacing with the popular OP.GG platform, delivering champion statistics, player profiles, and live meta insights. It is ideally suited for players seeking to improve their gameplay through matchup analysis, synergy guides, and pro-build references, as well as for analysts tracking esports schedules and team standings. Key capabilities include retrieving detailed summoner match histories, obtaining champion-specific lane guides and counterpicks, accessing current meta tier lists, and getting TFT-specific build recommendations for augments and item combinations.

osint intelligence.description: This server provides OSINT (Open-Source Intelligence) tools for cybersecurity and reconnaissance, enabling users to gather public information about domains, networks, and hosts through lookups, scans, and DNS analysis.
osint intelligence.llm_summary: This server provides a suite of OSINT tools specifically for cybersecurity reconnaissance, allowing users to collect and analyze publicly available information about internet assets. It is best suited for security assessments, threat intelligence gathering, and initial footprinting of domains, IP addresses, and networks. Its key capabilities include performing WHOIS and DNS record lookups, conducting network scans with Nmap, generating domain permutation lists for phishing detection with DNSTwist, and compiling comprehensive OSINT overviews.

pabal mcp.description: Manages App Store Connect and Google Play Console metadata, releases, and ASO workflows locally through MCP tools, enabling store management directly from AI clients without manual console navigation.

osmosis.description: An MCP server that enables querying and executing token swaps on the Osmosis blockchain with in-given-out and out-given-in pricing.

pdftotext mcp server.description: A reliable server for extracting text from PDF documents using the poppler-utils' pdftotext utility, compatible with any Model Context Protocol client.
pdftotext mcp server.llm_summary: This server specializes in extracting raw text content from PDF documents using the proven pdftotext utility from poppler-utils, providing a reliable foundation for text-based analysis. It is ideally suited for tasks like document indexing, content summarization, or feeding PDF text into language models for processing, where the structure and formatting of the original PDF are secondary. Its core capability is delivered through a single, focused tool that reads and returns the extracted plain text from any provided PDF file path.

pdf-tools mcp server.description: Enables PDF generation from HTML, text, and Markdown content with customizable formatting options. Provides secure cross-platform PDF creation tools that automatically save to user directories like Downloads, Documents, or Desktop.
pdf-tools mcp server.llm_summary: This server specializes in PDF document processing and generation, enabling users to create PDFs from HTML, text, and Markdown with custom formatting and automatically saving them to common user directories. It is best suited for tasks involving document automation, report generation, and content analysis where PDF manipulation is required. Key capabilities include extracting and summarizing text, adding watermarks or headers/footers, analyzing page layouts, answering questions about PDF content, and precisely replacing text at specific positions within documents.

perfetto mcp.description: Enables natural language analysis of Perfetto traces to diagnose Android app performance issues like ANRs, jank, CPU hotspots, memory leaks, and lock contention without writing SQL queries.
perfetto mcp.llm_summary: This server enables natural language analysis of Perfetto trace files to diagnose Android application performance problems, eliminating the need to write SQL queries manually. It is specifically designed for developers and performance engineers troubleshooting issues like application non-responsiveness (ANRs), UI jank, CPU bottlenecks, and memory leaks within Android apps. Its key capabilities include detecting and analyzing ANRs and janky frames, profiling CPU usage and Binder transactions, identifying memory leak suspects via heap analysis, and pinpointing thread lock contention.

penpot.description: An MCP server that enables access to Penpot design projects, files, and objects for retrieval, search, and export operations.

It is ideally suited for design workflows where users need to query specific components, inspect file structures, or extract design assets for documentation or implementation. Key capabilities include listing and navigating projects, fetching individual objects or entire file trees, searching for specific design elements, and exporting rendered components or objects in various formats.

outscraper mcp server.description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides access to Outscraper's data extraction services, implementing 8 tools for extracting data from Google services and domains including Maps, Reviews, Search, and contact information.
outscraper mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables data extraction from Google's public services through Outscraper's API, primarily for gathering business intelligence and contact details. It is ideally suited for tasks like competitive analysis, lead generation, and sentiment analysis by collecting real-world business listings and customer feedback. Its key capabilities include scraping detailed Google Maps reviews for specific locations and performing comprehensive searches on Google Maps to extract business information, ratings, and contact data.

persistent terminal mcp server.description: Enables AI assistants to create and manage persistent terminal sessions that continue running even after disconnection, with features like smart output management, web UI visualization, and automatic bug fixing with Codex integration.

It excels at managing ongoing operations like server monitoring, continuous builds, or data processing pipelines where maintaining state is crucial. Key capabilities include creating/managing multiple terminals, reading/writing to sessions, smart output filtering, visualizing sessions through a web UI, and integrating with Codex for automated bug fixing within terminal contexts.

Key capabilities include sending and receiving SMS messages, initiating phone calls, organizing and retrieving categorized snippets of text, managing a contact list, checking the device's battery level, and triggering device notifications or timers.

pinecone.description: An MCP server that enables document search, indexing, and record management with advanced retrieval and reranking capabilities using Pinecone.

prd creator mcp server.description: A specialized Model Context Protocol server that enables AI systems to generate detailed, well-structured product requirement documents through a standardized interface.

rabbitmq mcp server.description: A Model Context Protocol server built with mcp-framework that allows users to integrate RabbitMQ messaging capabilities with Claude AI.
rabbitmq mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables Claude AI to manage RabbitMQ messaging infrastructure through comprehensive administrative tools, allowing users to perform operations like creating bindings between exchanges and queues, deleting users, connections, policies, and virtual hosts. It is best suited for system administrators and developers needing to automate RabbitMQ configuration management, monitor messaging components, and perform bulk cleanup or maintenance tasks. Key capabilities include granular control over permissions, parameters, and resource limits, along with specialized operations for managing streams, exchanges, queues, and user access across the messaging system.

quickchart-mcp-server.description:
This Model Context Protocol (MCP) server provides powerful visualization tools using QuickChart.io APIs.  
With this MCP, AI assistants can create charts, diagrams, barcodes, QR codes, word clouds, tables, and more.
quickchart-mcp-server.llm_summary: This server enables AI assistants to generate a wide variety of visualizations and graphics, primarily using the QuickChart.io service. It is best suited for tasks requiring on-demand creation of charts, diagrams, barcodes, QR codes, and word clouds for data presentation, information encoding, or visual summaries. Key capabilities include generating charts via multiple libraries (Chart.js, ApexCharts, Google Charts), creating diagrams with Graphviz, producing functional codes and watermarks, and providing tools to download or link to the generated images.

qwen mcp tool.description: Enables AI assistants to leverage Qwen's code analysis capabilities with large context windows, supporting file/directory analysis, sandbox execution, and multiple approval modes for safe code operations.
qwen mcp tool.llm_summary: This server provides AI assistants with access to Qwen's specialized code analysis, utilizing large context windows to process and understand complex codebases. It is ideally suited for tasks like deep code review, understanding project structures, and safely executing or analyzing code within a controlled sandbox environment. Its key capabilities include analyzing files and directories, running code in isolation, and offering configurable approval modes to govern code execution for security.

railway mcp server.description: Enables interaction with Railway cloud platform through the CLI to manage projects, services, deployments, and environments. Supports creating projects, deploying templates, managing environment variables, and monitoring logs through natural language commands.

It is ideally suited for developers and DevOps tasks like provisioning new projects from templates, deploying code, configuring environment variables, and monitoring application logs. Key capabilities include creating and linking projects or environments, deploying services, generating domains, listing deployments and variables, and streaming real-time logs for debugging.

random-number.description: An MCP server that generates random numbers, securely samples data, and produces cryptographic tokens using various randomization tools.
random-number.llm_summary: This server specializes in generating various types of random data, primarily serving applications that require randomization, sampling, and cryptographic security. It is particularly well-suited for tasks like data shuffling, statistical sampling, secure token generation, and any scenario requiring controlled randomness. Key capabilities include generating integers and floats within specified ranges, securely sampling and shuffling datasets, producing cryptographically secure random integers, and creating secure hexadecimal tokens for authentication or security purposes.

rag memory mcp.description: An advanced MCP server providing RAG-enabled memory through a knowledge graph with vector search capabilities, enabling intelligent information storage, semantic retrieval, and document processing.
rag memory mcp.llm_summary: This server provides an intelligent memory system that stores and retrieves information using a knowledge graph enhanced with vector search (RAG). It is particularly well-suited for tasks requiring semantic understanding and connection of information, such as document analysis, research assistance, and building persistent, queryable knowledge bases. Its key capabilities include processing documents into semantic chunks, extracting and linking entities within a knowledge graph, and performing hybrid searches that combine graph relationships with vector similarity for nuanced information retrieval.

addObservations.description: Adds observations to existing entities in the knowledge base.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to add observations to.

chunkDocument.description: Splits a document into smaller text chunks with specified token limits and overlap.

documentId.description: Unique identifier of the document to chunk.

maxTokens.description: Maximum number of tokens per chunk.

overlap.description: Number of overlapping tokens between consecutive chunks.

createEntities.description: Creates new entities in the knowledge base with specified types and observations.

name.description: Name of the entity to create.

entityType.description: Type/category of the entity (e.g., PERSON, CONCEPT).

observations.description: Initial observations associated with the entity.

createRelations.description: Establishes relationships between entities in the knowledge base.

deleteDocuments.description: Deletes documents from the knowledge base by their identifiers.

documentIds.description: List of document identifiers to delete.

deleteEntities.description: Deletes entities from the knowledge base by their names.

entityNames.description: List of entity names to delete.

deleteObservations.description: Removes specific observations from entities in the knowledge base.

entityName.description: Name of the entity to remove observations from.

observations.description: List of observation texts to delete.

deleteRelations.description: Deletes relationships between entities from the knowledge base.

from.description: Source entity name of the relationship.

to.description: Target entity name of the relationship.

embedAllEntities.description: Embeds all entities in the knowledge graph.

embedChunks.description: Embeds document chunks for retrieval and analysis.

documentId.description: The unique identifier of the document to embed chunks from.

extractTerms.description: Extracts relevant terms from a document based on configurable criteria.
extractTerms.input_type: document identifier and term extraction criteria

documentId.description: The unique identifier of the document to extract terms from.

minLength.description: The minimum length of terms to extract.

includeCapitalized.description: Whether to include capitalized terms in the extraction.

customPatterns.description: Custom regular expression patterns to match and extract specific terms.

getDetailedContext.description: Retrieves detailed context for a specific chunk, optionally including surrounding content.
getDetailedContext.input_type: chunk identifier and surrounding content flag

chunkId.description: The unique identifier of the chunk to retrieve context for.

includeSurrounding.description: Whether to include surrounding text in the context.

getKnowledgeGraphStats.description: Retrieves statistical information about the knowledge graph.

hybridSearch.description: Performs a hybrid search combining text and graph-based retrieval.

query.description: The search query to execute.

limit.description: The maximum number of results to return.

useGraph.description: Whether to include graph-based results in the search.

linkEntitiesToDocument.description: Links specified entities to a document in the knowledge graph.
linkEntitiesToDocument.input_type: document identifier and entity names list

documentId.description: The unique identifier of the document to link entities to.

entityNames.description: A list of entity names to link to the document.

listDocuments.description: Lists all available documents in the system.

openNodes.description: Opens or creates nodes with the specified names in the knowledge graph.

names.description: List of node names to open or create.

readGraph.description: Retrieves the entire knowledge graph structure.

searchNodes.description: Searches for nodes matching a query string with an optional result limit.
searchNodes.input_type: node search query and result limit

query.description: Search query string for node matching.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

storeDocument.description: Stores a document with associated metadata in the system.

id.description: Unique identifier for the document.

content.description: Main content of the document to store.

metadata.description: Additional metadata associated with the document.

qweather-mcp.llm_summary: This server provides comprehensive weather data and forecasts through integration with the QWeather API, delivering real-time and predictive environmental information. It is ideally suited for applications requiring detailed meteorological insights, such as travel planning, event coordination, agricultural management, and public health advisories related to air quality. Its key capabilities include retrieving current conditions, hourly and daily forecasts, precipitation alerts, air quality indices, and official weather warnings for specific locations.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve air quality data for.

get-air-quality-daily.description: Retrieves daily air quality forecasts for a specified city.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve daily air quality forecasts for.

get-air-quality-hourly.description: Retrieves hourly air quality forecasts for a specified city.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve hourly air quality forecasts for.

get-hourly-forecast.description: Retrieves hourly weather forecasts for a specified city and duration.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve hourly forecasts for.

hours.description: Duration of the forecast in hours (e.g., '24h').

get-minutely-precipitation.description: Retrieves minute-by-minute precipitation data for a specified city.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve precipitation data for.

get-weather-forecast.description: Retrieves multi-day weather forecasts for a specified city.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve weather forecasts for.

days.description: Duration of the forecast in days (e.g., '7d').

get-weather-indices.description: Retrieves weather indices (like UV, comfort) for a specified city, type, and duration.
get-weather-indices.input_type: city name, index type, and duration

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve weather indices for.

type.description: Type of weather index (e.g., '1' for UV index).

get-weather-now.description: Retrieves current weather conditions for a specified city.

cityName.description: Name of the city to retrieve current weather data for.

get-weather-warning.description: Retrieves weather warnings for a specified city.

cityName.description: The name of the city for which to retrieve the weather warning

react native mcp server.description: Provides comprehensive React Native development assistance with expert-level automated code remediation, security vulnerability fixes, performance optimization, and production-ready code generation. Includes testing suite generation, dependency management, and accessibility compliance tools.
react native mcp server.llm_summary: This server provides expert-level React Native development assistance focused on automated code improvement and production readiness. It excels at tasks like performance optimization, security vulnerability remediation, generating production-ready components, and ensuring accessibility compliance. Key capabilities include comprehensive codebase analysis, automated code refactoring and debugging, test suite generation, and providing architecture advice for robust mobile applications.

analyze_codebase_comprehensive.description: Analyzes the entire codebase for potential issues, code quality, and best practices.

analyze_codebase_performance.description: Analyzes the codebase for performance bottlenecks and optimization opportunities.

analyze_component.description: Analyzes a specific component for structure, efficiency, and adherence to design patterns.

analyze_test_coverage.description: Analyzes the test coverage of the codebase to identify untested areas.

analyze_testing_strategy.description: Evaluates the overall testing strategy for completeness and effectiveness.

architecture_advice.description: Provides architectural recommendations based on project type and required features.

project_type.description: The type of the project (e.g., simple_app, complex_app).

features.description: List of features the project should support.

check_for_updates.description: Checks for available updates to the codebase, dependencies, or tools.

debug_issue.description: Helps debug a specific issue by analyzing the type, platform, and error message.

issue_type.description: The type of issue (e.g., crash, memory_leak, ui_rendering).

platform.description: The platform where the issue occurs (e.g., android, ios).

error_message.description: The error message or description of the problem.

generate_component_test.description: Generates test cases for a React Native component with specified testing frameworks and coverage options.

component_code.description: The source code of the React Native component to test.

component_name.description: The name of the component being tested.

get_version_info.description: Retrieves version information about the React Native MCP Server.

optimize_performance.description: Optimizes performance for specific React Native rendering scenarios.

refactor_component.description: Refactors a React Native component for specific improvements and compatibility.
refactor_component.input_type: component source code and refactoring instructions

code.description: The source code of the component to refactor.

target_rn_version.description: Target React Native version for compatibility.

include_tests.description: Whether to include test updates in the refactoring.

remediate_code.description: Automatically fixes code issues and enforces best practices in React Native components.
remediate_code.input_type: source code and code issues list

preserve_formatting.description: Whether to maintain original code formatting.

add_comments.description: Whether to add explanatory comments for changes.

random-generator.description: An MCP server that generates random integers, floats, strings, bytes, UUIDs, choices, and booleans for diverse applications.
random-generator.llm_summary: This MCP server provides a comprehensive suite of tools for generating various types of random data, serving as a versatile utility for applications requiring randomization and unpredictability. It is ideally suited for tasks like simulation, testing, data anonymization, game mechanics, or any process needing random seeds, selections, or identifiers. Its key capabilities include producing random integers and floats within specified ranges, generating random strings and bytes, making weighted or unweighted choices from a list, creating UUIDs, and generating random boolean values.

generate_random_boolean.description: Generates a random boolean value (true or false).

generate_random_choice.description: Selects random items from a list of choices.

choices.description: List of possible values to choose from.

count.description: Number of items to select.

generate_random_float.description: Generates a random floating-point number between 0 and 1.

random.org mcp server.description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides access to api.random.org for generating true random numbers, strings, UUIDs, and more.
random.org mcp server.llm_summary: This server provides access to true random data generation via the random.org API, enabling the production of verifiably random numbers, strings, and identifiers for applications requiring high-quality randomness. It is ideally suited for security-sensitive tasks, statistical sampling, simulations, lottery systems, or any use case where pseudo-random number generators are insufficient. Its key capabilities include generating integers within custom ranges, decimal fractions, Gaussian-distributed numbers, unique strings, UUIDs, binary blobs, and sequences, as well as checking API usage quotas.

generateBlobs.description: Generates random binary data blobs of specified size and encoding format.

size.description: Size of each blob in bytes.

generateDecimalFractions.description: Generates random decimal fractions between 0 and 1 with specified precision.

n.description: Number of decimal fractions to generate.

decimalPlaces.description: Number of decimal places for precision.

generateGaussians.description: Generates random numbers from a Gaussian (normal) distribution.

n.description: Number of Gaussian values to generate.

significantDigits.description: Number of significant digits for precision.

generateIntegerSequences.description: Generates sequences of random integers within a specified range.

n.description: Number of integer sequences to generate.

replacement.description: Whether to allow repeated values in sequences.

base.description: Numerical base for output (e.g., 10 for decimal).

generateIntegers.description: Generates random integers within a specified range.

base.description: Numerical base for output (e.g., 10 for decimal).

generateStrings.description: Generates random strings of specified length using custom character sets.

characters.description: Custom character set to use for string generation.

replacement.description: Whether to allow repeated characters in strings.

getUsage.description: Retrieves account usage statistics for the Random.org service.

react native debugger mcp.description: An MCP server that connects to your React Native application debugger
react native debugger mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server connects directly to a React Native application's debugger, providing real-time insights into running apps. It is best suited for development and debugging tasks, allowing developers to monitor app state and diagnose issues during active sessions. Its key capabilities include listing currently connected React Native applications and streaming the console logs from a specific app for immediate troubleshooting.

getConnectedApps.description: Retrieves a list of connected applications via the Metro server

metroServerPort.description: Port number of the Metro server to connect to

readConsoleLogsFromApp.description: Reads console logs from a specific connected application
readConsoleLogsFromApp.input_type: connected application identifier and maximum log count

id.description: Application package/identifier

maxLogs.description: Maximum number of logs to retrieve

reactbits mcp server.description: A Model Context Protocol server that provides AI assistants with access to ReactBits.dev components - a collection of 135+ animated React components for creative developers.
reactbits mcp server.llm_summary: This server provides AI assistants with direct access to ReactBits.dev's library of over 135 animated React components, enabling them to fetch specific code and implementation details. It is ideally suited for developers and teams building interactive UIs who need to quickly discover, preview, and integrate pre-built, animated React elements into their projects. Key capabilities include searching and listing components by category or name, retrieving the actual component source code with the `get_component` tool, and accessing live demo code examples via `get_component_demo` to see components in action.

get_component.description: Retrieves a specific component by name with optional style format

style.description: Style format for the component (e.g., 'css')

get_component_demo.description: Fetches a demo implementation for a specified component

name.description: Name of the component to retrieve a demo for

search_components.description: Searches components by query with optional category filter and result limit

query.description: Search term for component discovery

category.description: Optional category filter for search results

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

rdw mcp server.description: Provides tools to query Dutch vehicle registration data through the official RDW open API, allowing users to look up vehicle information by license plate, retrieve fuel/emissions data, and search vehicles by brand and model.
rdw mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables querying of Dutch vehicle registration data through the official RDW open API, primarily for retrieving detailed information about vehicles registered in the Netherlands. It is best suited for tasks like vehicle history checks, verifying technical specifications, and accessing environmental data such as fuel type and emissions. Its key capability, provided through the license plate lookup tool, allows users to fetch comprehensive vehicle details—including brand, model, and official registration data—directly by entering a Dutch license plate number.

rdw-license-plate-lookup.description: Retrieves vehicle registration details using a Dutch license plate number.

kenteken.description: Dutch license plate number in the format X-XXX-XX or similar

quickbase mcp server.description: Provides a standardized interface for interacting with Quickbase's JSON RESTful API through Claude and other MCP clients, supporting operations like querying records, managing table relationships, and handling file attachments.
quickbase mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables MCP clients to interact with QuickBase applications by providing a standardized bridge to its JSON RESTful API. It is ideally suited for automating data workflows, such as querying and updating records, managing relational data across tables, and handling file attachments within QuickBase. Its key capabilities include executing complex queries, manipulating records, navigating table relationships, and managing associated files, all through a unified interface for Claude and other clients.

check_configuration.description: Checks the configuration status of the Quickbase MCP Server

react native upgrader mcp.description: Streamlines React Native CLI project upgrades by providing automated tools to generate detailed diffs and migration guidance between any React Native versions. Uses rn-diff-purge to help developers seamlessly upgrade or downgrade their projects with step-by-step instructions.
react native upgrader mcp.llm_summary: This server automates React Native project upgrades by providing detailed version comparisons and migration guidance between any React Native versions. It is specifically designed for developers needing to upgrade or downgrade CLI projects, offering step-by-step instructions to streamline the process. Its key capabilities include fetching exact version differences, retrieving both stable and release candidate version information, and analyzing a user's current project version to determine necessary migration steps.

get-rc-version.description: Retrieves the latest React Native release candidate version.

get-react-native-diff.description: Generates a diff between two React Native versions.

fromVersion.description: The starting React Native version for comparison.

toVersion.description: The ending React Native version for comparison.

get-stable-version.description: Retrieves the latest stable React Native version.

get-user-version.description: Checks if a specific React Native version exists.

version.description: The React Native version to check for existence.

read-website-fast.description: Fast, token-efficient web content extraction tool that converts websites to clean Markdown for AI agents, featuring smart caching, content extraction with Mozilla Readability, and polite crawling capabilities.
read-website-fast.llm_summary: This server efficiently extracts and converts web content into clean Markdown format using Mozilla Readability, making it ideal for AI agents that need to process web information. It excels at tasks like research, content summarization, and data gathering from websites while prioritizing token efficiency and polite crawling to respect server resources. Its key capabilities include smart caching to avoid redundant fetches and a specialized tool that delivers structured, text-focused content from URLs, stripping away unnecessary web page clutter.

read_website.description: Reads content from a specified website quickly.

url.description: The URL of the website to read.

pages.description: The number of pages to read from the website.

readwise mcp enhanced.description: A comprehensive MCP server that unifies Readwise Reader document management with full Readwise highlights functionality, featuring AI-powered text processing and 94% reduction in token usage. Enables saving, searching, and managing documents and highlights through natural language with advanced content controls and spaced repetition learning.
readwise mcp enhanced.llm_summary: This server provides unified access to Readwise's document and highlight ecosystem, enabling users to save articles, manage their reading list, and interact with their saved highlights through natural language commands. It excels at personal knowledge management, allowing for AI-enhanced searching of saved content, organizing materials with tags, and facilitating spaced repetition learning via daily reviews. Key capabilities include saving and deleting documents, creating and exporting highlights, performing semantic searches across notes, and retrieving books or highlights for specific topics.

location.description: Location in the source (e.g., page number).

readwise_export_highlights.description: Exports all highlights in a structured format.

image_url.description: URL to an associated image for the document.

location.description: Updated storage location (e.g., 'new').

reddit buddy mcp.description: Enables AI assistants to browse Reddit, search posts, analyze user activity, and fetch comments without requiring API keys. Features smart caching, clean data responses, and optional authentication for higher rate limits.
reddit buddy mcp.llm_summary: This server enables AI assistants to interact with Reddit content by browsing subreddits, searching posts, fetching detailed post information, and analyzing user activity profiles, all without requiring API keys from the user. It is ideally suited for tasks like researching community discussions, gathering public opinions on topics, or investigating user posting histories across the platform. Key capabilities include retrieving clean, structured data from posts and comments, providing explanations of Reddit-specific terms or contexts, and offering smart caching with optional authentication for enhanced rate limits during data collection.

browse_subreddit.description: Browse a subreddit with sorting and filtering options.

subreddit.description: Name of the subreddit to browse.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

get_post_details.description: Retrieve detailed information about a specific Reddit post.

reddit_explain.description: Explain a Reddit-related term or concept.

term.description: The term or concept to explain (e.g., 'karma').

search_reddit.description: Search Reddit posts and comments across specified subreddits.

subreddits.description: List of subreddit names to search within.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

user_analysis.description: Analyze a Reddit user's activity and preferences.

posts_limit.description: Maximum number of posts to analyze.

comments_limit.description: Maximum number of comments to analyze.

top_subreddits_limit.description: Maximum number of top subreddits to list.

ref.llm_summary: This MCP server provides reference and documentation lookup capabilities, allowing users to retrieve and search through technical documentation directly. It is particularly useful for developers needing to quickly access API references, language documentation, or technical specifications during coding or troubleshooting sessions. The server offers two key tools: one to read and extract content from specific documentation URLs, and another to perform targeted searches across documentation sets to find relevant information.

ref_read_url.description: Reads and retrieves content from a specified URL.

url.description: The URL to read content from.

ref_search_documentation.description: Searches documentation for a given query.

query.description: The search query for documentation.

reddit-mcp.description: This repository contains a Model Context Protocol server implementation for Reddit that allows AI assistants to access and interact with Reddit content through PRAW (Python Reddit API Wrapper).
reddit-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server enables AI assistants to interact with Reddit's platform programmatically, primarily for reading content, analyzing community data, and participating in discussions. It is ideally suited for tasks like monitoring subreddit trends, gathering user or post information for research, and automating basic engagement such as posting or replying. Its key capabilities include fetching posts and subreddit details by ID or URL, retrieving top or trending content, obtaining user and subreddit statistics, and creating posts or comments directly.

get_top_posts.description: Retrieves the top posts from a subreddit based on a time filter and limit.
get_top_posts.input_type: subreddit name, time range, and post limit

subreddit.description: The subreddit to fetch top posts from (e.g., 'askreddit').

time_filter.description: The time range for top posts (e.g., 'month').

limit.description: The maximum number of posts to return.

redis mcp.description: Enables AI assistants to perform comprehensive Redis database operations including managing strings, hashes, lists, sets, sorted sets, TTL management, and data backup/restore. Supports secure connections and provides batch operations for efficient Redis interaction through natural language.
redis mcp.llm_summary: This server provides a full-featured interface for AI assistants to manage and interact with Redis databases using natural language, enabling operations across all major Redis data types like strings, hashes, lists, sets, and sorted sets. It is ideally suited for automating database administration, performing complex data queries, and managing application data caches or session stores directly through conversational commands. Key capabilities include granular key and data structure manipulation, TTL and expiration management, pattern-based key operations, and creating or restoring complete database backups for data persistence.

backup_restore.description: Restores a Redis database from a backup file.

field.description: Name of the field to retrieve.

field.description: The field name in the hash.

value.description: The value to assign to the field.

recraft.description: An MCP server that enables image generation, style creation, background editing, vectorization, and multiple upscaling options using Recraft AI tools.
recraft.llm_summary: This MCP server provides access to Recraft AI's specialized suite of image generation and editing tools, enabling both creation and sophisticated manipulation of visual assets. It is ideally suited for graphic design tasks, marketing content creation, and workflows requiring consistent artistic styles, such as generating branded imagery or refining product photos. Key capabilities include generating new images from prompts, creating reusable visual styles, performing targeted edits like background removal or replacement, converting images to vectors, and applying different types of upscaling for quality enhancement.

redis.description: An MCP server that provides Redis-compatible key-value storage with support for strings, hashes, sets, and sorted sets operations.
redis.llm_summary: This server provides Redis-compatible key-value storage operations, enabling tools to interact with a Redis database for data persistence and retrieval. It is best suited for tasks requiring structured data storage, caching mechanisms, session management, or implementing leaderboards and real-time analytics. Its key capabilities include storing and fetching strings, managing hashes for object-like data, performing set operations for unique collections, and handling sorted sets with range queries for ranked data.

rgb lightning network mcp server.description: Enables AI assistants to interact with RGB assets, Lightning Network operations, and Bitcoin transactions through RGB Lightning Node APIs. Supports asset management, invoice creation/payment, channel management, on-chain transactions, and asset swaps.
rgb lightning network mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables AI assistants to manage RGB smart contract assets and conduct Bitcoin Lightning Network operations, serving as a bridge to decentralized finance on Bitcoin. It is ideally suited for tasks like managing tokenized assets, executing instant micropayments via Lightning invoices, and performing atomic swaps between different assets. Key capabilities include checking asset balances and metadata, creating and paying Lightning invoices, sending on-chain Bitcoin and RGB assets, managing payment channels, and facilitating trustless asset exchanges.

repomix.description: An MCP server that packages local or remote code repositories and enables searching and reading of their contents efficiently.
repomix.llm_summary: This MCP server specializes in packaging and analyzing code repositories, allowing users to efficiently work with both local and remote codebases as a single, searchable unit. It is ideally suited for tasks like code exploration, understanding unfamiliar projects, or performing targeted searches across an entire codebase without manual setup. Its key capabilities include packing repositories into a structured format, reading specific files or directories, and performing powerful grep-like searches across the entire packaged output.

rijksmuseum-server.description: An MCP server that enables searching, viewing, and exploring artworks and artist timelines from the Rijksmuseum collection.
rijksmuseum-server.llm_summary: This MCP server provides direct access to the vast Rijksmuseum collection, allowing users to search for artworks, retrieve detailed information and high-quality images, and explore curated user sets. It is ideally suited for art historical research, educational projects, and personal exploration of Dutch art and history. Key capabilities include searching the collection, viewing artist timelines, obtaining detailed artwork metadata, and opening high-resolution images directly in a browser for closer examination.

ripgrep.llm_summary: This server provides rapid text searching and file system exploration by leveraging the powerful ripgrep search engine. It is ideally suited for developers and analysts needing to quickly find code patterns, analyze codebases, or gather file statistics within a project directory. Its key capabilities include performing regex and plain-text searches with advanced filters, counting match occurrences across files, and listing all files or discoverable file types within a given search path.

rhino.description: An MCP server that manages and modifies 3D geometry in Rhino using Python scripts and object manipulation tools.
rhino.llm_summary: This MCP server enables direct manipulation of 3D geometry within Rhino by executing Python scripts and managing objects and layers programmatically. It is ideally suited for automating repetitive modeling tasks, batch editing complex geometries, and integrating Rhino workflows with external systems. Key capabilities include creating and modifying objects and layers, executing custom RhinoScript Python code, retrieving detailed object and document information, and managing object selection states for targeted operations.

rollbar-mcp.description: An MCP server that retrieves Rollbar project data, errors, occurrences, and user information across environments.
rollbar-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server provides comprehensive access to Rollbar's error and performance monitoring data, enabling users to retrieve detailed information about projects, errors, deployments, and users across different environments. rss3.description: An MCP server that retrieves and manages decentralized social activities and AI data across networks via RSS3 protocols.
rss3.llm_summary: This MCP server specializes in retrieving and managing decentralized social activities and AI data across multiple networks using RSS3 protocols. It is best suited for analyzing on-chain social interactions, tracking cross-network user activity, and accessing structured AI data from decentralized sources. Key capabilities include fetching account activities across federated networks, retrieving AI data by specific paths, analyzing blockchain bridging transactions, and accessing detailed metrics like epoch APY snapshots and DSL request totals.

runway api mcp server.description: Enables AI video and image generation through the Runway API. Supports video generation from images and text prompts, image creation, video upscaling and editing, and task management.
runway api mcp server.llm_summary: This server provides AI-powered video and image generation and editing by connecting to the Runway API. It is ideally suited for creative tasks like producing marketing content, generating visual concepts from text descriptions, and enhancing or modifying existing video footage. Its key capabilities include generating videos from images or text prompts, creating images, upscaling video resolution, performing inpainting-based video edits, and managing the status of these asynchronous generation tasks.

rfc mcp server.description: An MCP server that enables programmatic access to IETF RFC documents, allowing users to fetch, search, and extract specific sections from RFCs.

It is ideally suited for network engineers, software developers, and researchers who need to reference or incorporate official protocol details into their work. Its key capabilities include fetching entire RFCs by number, extracting specific numbered sections from a document, and searching across the RFC corpus to find relevant documents.

salesforce.description: An MCP server that enables querying, managing, and manipulating Salesforce objects and records through comprehensive data operations.

scientific computing.description: This server provides in-memory tensor storage and basic linear algebra operations, such as matrix creation, arithmetic, inversion, and transposition, using NumPy arrays.
scientific computing.llm_summary: This server enables in-memory scientific computing by managing NumPy tensors and performing fundamental linear algebra operations, serving as a computational backend for mathematical analysis. It is ideally suited for tasks involving matrix manipulation, vector calculus, and numerical linear algebra, such as data transformations, solving systems of equations, and geometric projections. Its key capabilities include creating and managing tensors, performing matrix arithmetic (addition, multiplication, inversion), computing decompositions (QR, SVD, eigenvalues), and executing vector operations like dot products, cross products, and gradient calculations.

create_tensor.description:
Creates a NumPy array (matrix) with a specified shape and values.

    Args:
        shape (list[int]): The shape of the resulting array as a tuple(e.g., (2, 3)).
        values (list[float]): A flat list of values to populate the array.
        name (str): The name of the tensor to be stored.

    Returns:
        np.ndarray: A NumPy array with the specified shape.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the number of values does not match the product of the shape.
create_tensor.input_type: tensor shape and values with name

shape.description: Tensor shape as list of integers
shape.title: Shape

values.description: Flat list of floats to fill the tensor
values.title: Values

view_tensor.description:
Returns an immutable view of a previously stored NumPy tensor from the in-memory tensor store.

    Args:
        name (str): The name of the tensor as stored in the in-store dictionary
    Returns:
        dict: The in-store dictionary for tensors

delete_tensor.description:
Deletes a tensor from the in-memory tensor store.

    Args:
        name (str): The name of the tensor to delete.

    Raises:
        ValueError: If the tensor name is not found in the store or if an error occurs during deletion.

add_matrices.description:
Adds two stored tensors element-wise.

        Args:
            name_a (str): The name of the first tensor.
            name_b (str): The name of the second tensor.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The result of element-wise addition.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the tensor names are not found or shapes are incompatible.

subtract_matrices.description:
Adds two stored tensors element-wise.

        Args:
            name_a (str): The name of the first tensor.
            name_b (str): The name of the second tensor.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The result of element-wise subtraction.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the tensor names are not found or shapes are incompatible.

multiply_matrices.description:
Performs matrix multiplication between two stored tensors.

        Args:
            name_a (str): The name of the first tensor.
            name_b (str): The name of the second tensor.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The result of matrix multiplication.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If either tensor is not found or their shapes are incompatible.

scale_matrix.description:
Scales a stored tensor by a scalar factor.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the tensor to scale.
            scale_factor (float): The scalar value to multiply the tensor by.
            in_place (bool): If True, updates the stored tensor; otherwise, returns a new scaled tensor.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The scaled tensor.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the tensor name is not found in the store.

matrix_inverse.description:
Computes the inverse of a stored square matrix.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the tensor to invert.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The inverse of the matrix.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the matrix is not found, is not square, or is singular (non-invertible).

transpose.description:
Computes the transpose of a stored tensor.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the tensor to transpose.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The transposed tensor.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the tensor name is not found in the store.

determinant.description:
Computes the determinant of a stored square matrix.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the matrix.

        Returns:
            float: The determinant of the matrix.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the matrix is not found or is not square.

rank.description:
Computes the rank of a stored tensor.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the tensor.

        Returns:
            int | list[int]: The rank of the matrix.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the tensor name is not found in the store.

compute_eigen.description:
Computes the eigenvalues and right eigenvectors of a stored square matrix.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the tensor to analyze.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary with keys:
                - 'eigenvalues': np.ndarray
                - 'eigenvectors': np.ndarray

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the tensor is not found or is not a square matrix.

qr_decompose.description:
Computes the QR decomposition of a stored matrix.

        Decomposes the matrix A into A = Q @ R, where Q is an orthogonal matrix
        and R is an upper triangular matrix.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the matrix to decompose.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary with keys:
                - 'q': np.ndarray, the orthogonal matrix Q
                - 'r': np.ndarray, the upper triangular matrix R

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the matrix is not found or decomposition fails.

svd_decompose.description:
Computes the Singular Value Decomposition (SVD) of a stored matrix.

        Decomposes the matrix A into A = U @ S @ V^T, where U and V^T are orthogonal
        matrices, and S is a diagonal matrix of singular values.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the matrix to decompose.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary with keys:
                - 'u': np.ndarray, the left singular vectors
                - 's': np.ndarray, the singular values
                - 'v_t': np.ndarray, the right singular vectors transposed

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the matrix is not found or decomposition fails.

find_orthonormal_basis.description:
Finds an orthonormal basis for the column space of a stored matrix using QR decomposition.

        Args:
            name (str): The name of the matrix.

        Returns:
            list[list[float]]: A list of orthonormal basis vectors.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the matrix is not found or decomposition fails.

change_basis.description:
Changes the basis of a stored square matrix.

        Args:
            name (str): Name of the matrix in the tensor store.
            new_basis (list[list[float]]): Columns are new basis vectors.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: Representation of the matrix in the new basis.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the matrix name is not found or non-invertible.
change_basis.input_type: stored matrix name and new basis vectors

vector_project.description:
Projects a stored vector onto another vector.

        Args:
            name (str): Name of the stored vector to project.
            new_vector (list[float]): The vector to project onto.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: The projection result vector.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If the vector name is not found or projection fails.
vector_project.input_type: stored vector name and projection vector

vector_dot_product.description:
Computes the dot product between two stored vectors.

        Args:
            name_a (str): Name of the first vector in the tensor store.
            name_b (str): Name of the second vector in the tensor store.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: Scalar result of the dot product.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If either vector is not found or if the dot product computation fails.
vector_dot_product.input_type: first stored vector name and second stored vector name

vector_cross_product.description:
Computes the cross product of two stored vectors.

        Args:
            name_a (str): Name of the first vector in the tensor store.
            name_b (str): Name of the second vector in the tensor store.

        Returns:
            np.ndarray: Vector result of the cross product.

        Raises:
            ValueError: If either vector is not found or if the cross product computation fails.
vector_cross_product.input_type: first stored vector name and second stored vector name

gradient.description:
Computes the symbolic gradient of a scalar function.

        Args:
            f_str (str): A string representing a scalar function (e.g., "x**2 + y*z").

        Returns:
            str: A string representation of the symbolic gradient as a vector.

curl.description:
Computes the symbolic curl of a vector field, optionally evaluated at a point.

        Args:
            f_str (str): A string representing the vector field in list format (e.g., "[x+y, x, 2*z]").
            point (list[float], optional): A list of coordinates [x, y, z] to evaluate the curl numerically.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary with the symbolic curl as a string, and optionally the evaluated vector.
curl.input_type: vector field expression and evaluation point coordinates

divergence.description:
Computes the symbolic divergence of a vector field, optionally evaluated at a point.

        Args:
            f_str (str): A string representing the vector field in list format (e.g., "[x+y, x, 2*z]").
            point (list[float], optional): A list of coordinates [x, y, z] to evaluate the divergence numerically.

        Returns:
            dict: A dictionary with the symbolic divergence as a string, and optionally the evaluated scalar.
divergence.input_type: vector field expression and evaluation point coordinates

laplacian.description:
Computes the Laplacian of a scalar or vector field symbolically.

        Args:
            f_str (str): Scalar function as "x**2 + y*z" or vector "[Fx, Fy, Fz]".
            is_vector (bool): Set True to compute vector Laplacian.

        Returns:
            str: Symbolic result of the Laplacian—scalar or list of 3 components.
laplacian.input_type: scalar or vector field expression and vector flag

directional_deriv.description:
Computes symbolic directional derivative of scalar field along a vector direction.

        Args: f_str (str): Expression like "x*y*z". u (list[float]): Direction vector [vx, vy, vz]. unit (bool): True
        if u should be normalized before calculating directional derivative. Set to True by default.

        Returns:
            str: Symbolic result as string.
directional_deriv.input_type: scalar field expression and direction vector

plot_vector_field.description:
Plots a 3D vector field from a string "[u(x,y,z), v(x,y,z), w(x,y,z)]"

        Args:
            f_str: string representation of 3D field, e.g. "[z, -y, x]".
            bounds: (xmin, xmax, ymin, ymax, zmin, zmax)
            n: grid resolution per axis

        Returns: Displayed Matplotlib 3D quiver plot (no image return needed)

plot_function.description:
Plots a 2D or 3D mathematical function from a symbolic expression string.

        Args:
            expr_str: string representation of a function in x or x and y,
                      e.g. "x**2" or "sin(sqrt(x**2 + y**2))"
            xlim: (xmin, xmax) range for x-axis
            ylim: (ymin, ymax) range for y-axis (used in 2D or 3D)
            grid: resolution of the plot grid

        Returns:
            A rendered Image of the function using Matplotlib.
            - 2D plot if the expression contains only x
            - 3D surface plot if the expression contains both x and y

shell.description: An MCP server that executes shell commands and returns the output securely through the shell_exec tool.

siri-shortcuts.description: An MCP server that lists, opens, and runs Siri Shortcuts on Apple devices.

It is ideally suited for automating repetitive tasks on macOS or iOS, such as controlling smart home devices, processing files, or triggering complex multi-app sequences. seo mcp.description: An MCP server that analyzes backlinks, generates keywords, and evaluates keyword difficulty and traffic for SEO optimization.

It is best suited for SEO professionals and content creators who need to evaluate backlink profiles, assess the viability of target keywords, and discover new content opportunities. simctl.description: An MCP server that manages iOS simulators using Xcode's simctl tools for device control, app testing, and media capture.

slack.description: Interact with Slack Workspaces over the Slack API. Supports stdio and Streamable HTTP transport. Extended from Anthropic's archived server
slack.llm_summary: This server enables interaction with Slack workspaces through the Slack API, allowing users to read from and post messages to channels and threads. It is best suited for automating notifications, monitoring channel activity, and building conversational workflows directly within Slack. Key capabilities include posting messages and replies, adding emoji reactions, retrieving channel history and thread conversations, as well as listing channels and fetching user profile information.

sitemap.description: An MCP server that extracts and analyzes sitemap structures, pages, and content for website navigation and SEO insights.
sitemap.llm_summary: The sitemap MCP server specializes in extracting and analyzing website sitemap data to understand site structure and content for navigation and SEO purposes. It is ideally suited for tasks like auditing website architecture, planning content strategy, and conducting technical SEO analysis. Its key capabilities include fetching individual sitemap pages, generating statistical summaries of sitemap contents, visualizing the hierarchical page structure as a tree, and parsing the detailed content within sitemap entries.

smart-e2b.description: Enables secure execution of JavaScript and Python code in cloud-based E2B sandboxes with integrated file management capabilities, allowing Claude to run and test code safely in isolated environments.

sushimcp.llm_summary: This server specializes in retrieving and managing external specifications and model lists, primarily focusing on LLM configurations and API documentation. It is best suited for developers and AI practitioners who need to programmatically access and compare different language model details or integrate with services defined by OpenAPI specs. Its key capabilities include fetching specific LLM information from configured sources, retrieving OpenAPI specification documents, and listing the available sources for both types of data.

sumup mcp server.description: Enables natural language interactions with SumUp payment services and APIs, allowing users to manage their SumUp account, process payments, and access payment data through LLM-powered conversations.
sumup mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables natural language management of SumUp payment services, allowing users to process transactions, manage customer data, and control merchant accounts through conversational AI. It is ideally suited for merchants and business users to handle daily operations like creating checkouts, managing customer profiles, and administering team roles and hardware like card readers. Key capabilities include processing payments, creating and deactivating sub-accounts and checkouts, managing merchant members and permissions, and retrieving detailed account and transaction information.

swiftcode mcp server.description: A Model Context Protocol server that automates code generation for web development, specializing in creating TypeScript API clients from Swagger/OpenAPI specs and Vue.js components for frontend development.
swiftcode mcp server.llm_summary: This server automates web development workflows by generating TypeScript API clients from Swagger/OpenAPI specifications and creating Vue.js Single File Components (SFCs) for frontend interfaces. It is ideally suited for developers building full-stack applications who need to quickly scaffold consistent, type-safe client code and UI components from API definitions. Its key capabilities include producing ready-to-use API client libraries, generating complete Vue components with integrated client logic, and creating template-based component structures to accelerate frontend development.

svn mcp server.description: A complete Model Context Protocol server for Subversion (SVN) integration, designed to allow AI agents to efficiently manage SVN repositories.
svn mcp server.llm_summary: This MCP server enables AI agents to perform comprehensive Subversion (SVN) version control operations, allowing for direct interaction with SVN repositories. It is ideally suited for automating source code management workflows, such as committing changes, reviewing history, and synchronizing local working copies with a central repository. Key capabilities include checking out and updating code, committing and reverting changes, examining file differences and logs, and managing repository health and authentication.

tapp exchange mcp server.description: Enables AI agents to interact with Tapp Exchange, a decentralized exchange on Aptos blockchain. Supports pool management, trading operations across AMM/CLMM/Stable pools, liquidity provision, and position tracking through natural language.
tapp exchange mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables AI agents to manage decentralized finance operations on the Aptos blockchain's Tapp Exchange, allowing users to interact with pools and execute trades through natural language. It is best suited for automated liquidity provision, complex multi-pool trading, and managing concentrated and stablecoin liquidity positions across different AMM types. Key capabilities include creating and adding liquidity to AMM, CLMM, and Stable pools, executing swaps with route estimation, and removing liquidity in single or multiple transactions while tracking fees and positions.

taskflow.description: An MCP server that manages task workflows with planning, tracking, and subtask coordination for efficient request handling.

structured-thinking.description: An MCP server that helps structure and refine thoughts using capture, revision, and retrieval tools for clearer thinking.

It is ideally suited for tasks like brainstorming, journaling, project planning, and any scenario requiring clarity and structured reasoning. Its key capabilities include capturing individual thoughts, revising existing ones, retrieving relevant past ideas based on context, clearing the history, and generating summaries of your thinking timeline.

thinking-models.description: An MCP server that helps users discover, evaluate, and apply reasoning models for problem solving using interactive analysis and recommendations.
thinking-models.llm_summary: This server helps users discover and apply structured reasoning models for problem-solving by providing tools to analyze learning systems, detect knowledge gaps, and generate validated hypotheses. It is best suited for tasks requiring strategic thinking, such as complex decision-making, learning design, and improving analytical processes. Key capabilities include interactive reasoning guidance, personalized model recommendations for specific problems, and the ability to create, update, and explore a library of thinking frameworks with usage statistics and feedback integration.

time.description: An MCP server that retrieves the current time and converts between time zones using location or offset inputs.
time.llm_summary: This server provides time-related data and conversions, primarily for retrieving the current time and transforming timestamps between different time zones. It is ideally suited for tasks like scheduling across regions, logging events with accurate timestamps, or building applications that require timezone-aware operations. Its key capabilities include fetching the current time for a specified location and converting a given time between zones using either geographic location names or UTC offsets.

thinkingcap.description: Multi-agent research server that runs multiple LLM providers in parallel with web search capabilities, synthesizing their responses into comprehensive answers for complex queries.
thinkingcap.llm_summary: This MCP server is a multi-agent research system that runs multiple LLM providers simultaneously and integrates web search to tackle complex queries by synthesizing parallel responses into comprehensive answers. It is ideally suited for in-depth research tasks, comparative analysis, and investigating multifaceted questions where aggregating diverse AI perspectives and current web data is crucial. Its key capabilities include enumerating available LLM providers via `list_providers` and executing coordinated, multi-source research operations through the `research` tool, which merges concurrent model outputs with search results.

research.description: Conducts research on a specified topic and returns search results.

query.description: The research question or topic to investigate.

maxSearchResults.description: The maximum number of search results to return.

todo markdown mcp server.description: An MCP server that allows AI assistants to manage todo lists stored in a simple markdown file, supporting creation, reading, updating, and deletion of todo items with persistent IDs.
todo markdown mcp server.llm_summary: This MCP server enables AI assistants to manage todo lists stored in a markdown file, providing persistent CRUD operations for task tracking. It is ideal for personal productivity workflows, project management assistance, and maintaining organized task lists through an AI interface. Key capabilities include adding new todos with automatic ID generation, listing all tasks, updating statuses or descriptions, deleting specific items, and clearing all completed tasks from the file.
