tencent rtc mcp server.description: The Tencent RTC MCP Server provides real-time communication capabilities such as audio and video chat. By integrating this MCP Server into your application or project, you can easily implement secure, high-quality real-time voice and video communication.
tencent rtc mcp server.llm_summary: This server provides integration tools and APIs for Tencent's Real-Time Communication (RTC) service, enabling developers to add secure, high-quality audio/video chat and live streaming features to web and native applications. It is best suited for building communication-focused applications like video conferencing systems, live broadcast platforms, interactive customer support, and social chat features. Its key capabilities include generating user authentication signatures (UserSig), providing SDKs and UI kits for both web and native platforms, and offering detailed integration guides for specific components like chat windows, call interfaces, and live room state management.

get_usersig.description: Generates a user signature (UserSig) for authentication based on the provided user ID.

get_faq.description: Fetches frequently asked questions (FAQs) related to a specific product and framework.

traveler.description: An MCP server that manages and tracks traveler journeys with location updates, settings, and personalized tips.
traveler.llm_summary: This MCP server manages and tracks active traveler journeys, handling real-time location updates, traveler profiles, and journey lifecycle events like starting and stopping trips. It is ideally suited for applications that need to monitor a traveler's progress, update their itinerary details, or provide context-aware assistance during a trip. Its key capabilities include retrieving and setting traveler information and location, controlling journey states, accessing user settings, and fetching personalized travel tips based on the current context.

todos.description: An MCP server that enables RESTful access to PostgreSQL databases using PostgREST for direct SQL-to-REST translation.
todos.llm_summary: This server provides RESTful access to PostgreSQL databases by leveraging PostgREST to automatically translate SQL operations into HTTP API calls. It is ideally suited for developers and analysts who need to programmatically query, insert, update, or delete data from a PostgREST-enabled PostgreSQL database without writing direct SQL or complex backend code. Its core capabilities include executing direct PostgREST HTTP requests and translating SQL statements into the corresponding REST API calls, enabling seamless database interactions through a standardized web interface.

tongyi-wanxiang.description: An MCP server that generates images and videos from text prompts using AI models.
tongyi-wanxiang.llm_summary: This server provides AI-powered image and video generation from text prompts using Alibaba Cloud's Tongyi Wanxiang models. It is ideally suited for creative tasks requiring visual content creation, such as generating artwork, illustrations, marketing assets, or short video clips from descriptive text. Its key capabilities include initiating and retrieving results for both text-to-image and text-to-video generation, allowing for the production of static visuals and dynamic video content.

travel-planner.description: An MCP server that plans and optimizes travel itineraries by organizing attractions, accommodations, and transportation options.
travel-planner.llm_summary: This MCP server specializes in generating and refining detailed travel plans by integrating key trip components like points of interest, places to stay, and transit connections. It is ideally used for automating vacation planning, business trip organization, or discovering travel options for a given destination. Its core capabilities include crafting full itineraries, searching for attractions and lodgings, comparing transportation methods, and intelligently optimizing an existing schedule for efficiency or preference.

tree-hugger-js mcp server.description: Provides AI agents with powerful JavaScript/TypeScript code analysis and transformation capabilities using the tree-hugger-js library.
tree-hugger-js mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables AI agents to perform deep structural analysis and manipulation of JavaScript/TypeScript code by leveraging the tree-hugger-js library for abstract syntax tree operations. It is particularly valuable for automated code refactoring, dependency management, and implementing consistent code patterns across a codebase. Key capabilities include extracting specific code elements like functions and imports, identifying and replacing code patterns, performing safe identifier renaming, and inserting or removing code segments while maintaining syntactic correctness.

tripo-mcp.description: An MCP server that enables 3D scene and object manipulation in Blender with asset integration from PolyHaven.
tripo-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server enables 3D modeling and scene manipulation within Blender, integrating asset sourcing from PolyHaven's library. It is ideal for automating 3D content creation workflows, generating objects from text descriptions, and populating scenes with high-quality pre-made assets. Key capabilities include creating and modifying 3D objects, applying materials and textures, executing custom Blender Python code, and searching for or downloading specific models and textures from the PolyHaven repository.

tv-recommender-mcp-server.llm_summary: This server specializes in television show discovery and recommendation, providing comprehensive access to show information, actor details, and viewing options. It is ideally suited for tasks like finding new series to watch, researching shows and their cast, or identifying where specific programs can be streamed. tung-shing.description: An MCP server that delivers traditional Chinese almanac data including auspicious dates and zodiac information using the get-tung-shing tool.
tung-shing.llm_summary: This server provides access to traditional Chinese almanac (Tung Shing) data, primarily for identifying auspicious dates and retrieving zodiac information for specific days. It is best suited for planning events, ceremonies, or activities according to traditional Chinese customs and for cultural or historical research. Its key capability, through the `get-tung-shing` tool, is delivering detailed daily almanac information including lucky and unlucky designations, traditional taboos, and associated astrological details.

get-tung-shing.description: Retrieves data from the Tung-Shing server.

twelve data mcp server.description: Provides integration with Twelve Data API to access financial market data including historical time series, real-time quotes, and instrument metadata for stocks, forex pairs, and cryptocurrencies.
twelve data mcp server.llm_summary: This server connects to the Twelve Data API to deliver comprehensive financial market data, enabling users to retrieve historical time series, real-time quotes, and detailed metadata for assets like stocks, forex, and cryptocurrencies. It is ideally suited for financial analysis, investment research, and building applications that require market monitoring, backtesting, or economic calendar integration. Key capabilities include accessing end-of-day and intraday price data, calculating technical indicators (like ADX and Bollinger Bands), checking market states, fetching corporate fundamentals such as dividends and earnings, and performing currency conversions.

typescript definition finder.description: A Model Context Protocol server that helps AI code editors locate TypeScript symbol definitions in codebases, particularly useful for finding original definitions of imported symbols and classes.
typescript definition finder.llm_summary: This server enables AI coding assistants to precisely locate TypeScript symbol definitions within a codebase, specifically addressing the challenge of tracing imported symbols back to their original source declarations. It is particularly valuable for development tasks like code navigation, understanding dependencies, and refactoring in complex TypeScript projects. Its core capability is the `find_typescript_definition` tool, which allows an AI to query and retrieve the exact file location and code of a symbol's definition, such as a class, function, or interface, even when referenced through imports.

It is ideally suited for real-time market research, tracking cultural and technological trends across different regions, and content discovery for analysis or curation. Its key capabilities include fetching ranked and trending lists from over 20 specific sources, allowing users to monitor popular articles, videos, and topics from platforms like Bilibili, Juejin, Tencent News, and The Paper in a unified way.

unit converter.description: An MCP server that provides comprehensive unit conversion capabilities across a wide range of physical quantities, transforming measurements between different unit systems.
unit converter.llm_summary: This MCP server provides comprehensive unit conversion capabilities across a wide range of physical quantities and data types, serving as a versatile utility for transforming measurements between different unit systems. It is ideally suited for scientific calculations, engineering tasks, data analysis, and any workflow requiring consistent unit management, such as converting temperature between Celsius and Fahrenheit or data storage between gigabytes and terabytes. Key capabilities include converting over 15 distinct categories—including length, mass, time, energy, pressure, and computer data—and it offers batch conversion and a tool to list all supported units for discoverability.

convert_batch.description:
Perform multiple unit conversions in a single batch request.

Each request in the batch should contain:
- value: The numeric value to convert
- from_unit: Source unit for conversion
- to_unit: Target unit for conversion
- conversion_type: Type of conversion (temperature, length, mass, etc.)
- request_id: Optional identifier for tracking individual requests

Returns a structured response with individual results for each conversion,
including success/failure status and either converted values or error messages.

usql mcp server.description: Enables AI assistants to execute SQL queries against any database supported by the usql CLI tool. Provides seamless database interaction through MCP by forwarding queries directly to usql and returning results in JSON or CSV format.
usql mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables AI assistants to execute SQL queries and scripts against a wide variety of databases supported by the usql CLI tool, providing seamless database interaction. url-context-mcp mcp.llm_summary: This server analyzes and summarizes web content by fetching and processing URLs through the Google Gemini API, with the optional capability to ground or supplement this information using Google Search. It is ideally suited for research tasks, content analysis, and fact-checking where understanding information from specific web pages is required. Its key capabilities include extracting and condensing URL content via `analyze_urls` and performing live web searches for additional context through the `google_search` tool.

variflight tripmatch mcp server.description: Provides tools to query flight and train information including flight searches, train tickets, weather forecasts, and transfer options between different transportation modes.
variflight tripmatch mcp server.llm_summary: This server specializes in multimodal travel planning by providing integrated flight and train data, enabling users to search for individual flights or train tickets and crucially find transfer options between these transportation modes. It is ideally suited for complex itinerary planning, cost comparison for specific routes, and checking travel conditions with airport weather forecasts. Its key capabilities include searching flights by route or number, finding train stations and tickets, calculating flight prices between cities, and accessing a unique "flight happiness index" alongside practical date and weather information.

flightHappinessIndex.description: Calculates passenger happiness index for a specific flight based on flight details.

getFlightAndTrainTransferInfo.description: Provides transfer options between flights and trains between cities on a specific date.

getFlightPriceByCities.description: Retrieves flight prices between specified cities on a given date.

getFutureWeatherByAirport.description: Fetches future weather forecasts for a specific airport.

searchFlightsByDepArr.description: Searches available flights between departure and arrival airports on a specific date.

searchFlightsByNumber.description: Retrieves detailed information for a specific flight number and date.

searchTrainStations.description: Searches train stations matching a given query string.

query.description: Search query (e.g., city name or station name)

to.description: The destination of the train journey.

vincent says mcp server.description: Enables users to ask questions to a persona named Vincent and get yes/no answers or personalized responses in Vincent's style. Provides a tool to simulate how Vincent would respond to various statements or questions.
vincent says mcp server.llm_summary: This server allows users to interact with a persona named Vincent, primarily to receive yes/no answers or responses styled in his unique manner. It is best suited for tasks like seeking quick decisions, exploring character-driven dialogue, or generating personalized replies that mimic a specific personality. Its key capability is the `ask_vincent` tool, which simulates how Vincent would respond to a wide range of user-provided statements or questions.

ask_vincent.description: Asks Vincent a question and returns the response.

vmware fusion mcp server.description: A Model Context Protocol server that allows managing VMware Fusion virtual machines through natural language, enabling users to list VMs, retrieve VM information, and perform power operations via the Fusion REST API.
vmware fusion mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables natural language management of VMware Fusion virtual machines by interfacing with the Fusion REST API. It is ideal for developers and IT professionals who need to remotely monitor and control their local virtual machine environments through an AI assistant. Its key capabilities include listing all available VMs, retrieving detailed VM information and current power states, and executing specific power operations like starting, stopping, or suspending individual machines.

vm_id.description: Unique identifier of the virtual machine.

vm_id.description: Unique identifier of the virtual machine.

vchart-mcp-server.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server for the @visactor/vchart that enables AI assistants to generate interactive charts and visualizations.
vchart-mcp-server.llm_summary: This MCP server enables AI assistants to create a wide variety of interactive charts and data visualizations using the VisActor/VChart library. It is ideally suited for tasks involving data analysis, report generation, and visual storytelling where dynamic charts are needed to illustrate trends, comparisons, or distributions. Its key capabilities include generating specific chart types like Cartesian plots, dual-axis charts, heatmaps, hierarchical diagrams, polar charts, progress indicators, range columns, Sankey diagrams, scatter plots, and wordcloud or Venn diagrams.

vizro-mcp.description: An MCP server that generates and validates data visualizations and dashboards using Vizro configurations and sample data analysis.
vizro-mcp.llm_summary: The vizro-mcp server specializes in creating and verifying data visualizations and dashboards by working with Vizro configuration frameworks. It is ideally used for planning, prototyping, and validating chart and dashboard designs before full implementation, ensuring they are correctly structured. Its key capabilities include generating schema-compliant plans, analyzing sample datasets to inform visualizations, and providing validation checks for both individual chart code and complete dashboard configurations.

vrchat-mcp.description: An MCP server that enables VRChat account management, avatar and world exploration, friend interactions, and group activities through automated actions.
vrchat-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server provides automated VRChat account management and social interaction capabilities, allowing users to programmatically manage their virtual presence. It is ideally suited for automating repetitive social tasks, exploring content, and managing connections—such as finding new avatars or worlds, handling friend requests, and coordinating group activities. Key capabilities include searching and selecting avatars and worlds, managing favorites and friends lists, creating/joining instances, interacting with groups, and handling invitations and notifications.

vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings.description: MCP Server that integrates various Vonage APIs as MCP tools, to make it easier for developers to work with and create Vonage applications.
vonage-mcp-server-api-bindings.llm_summary: This server provides direct access to Vonage's communication APIs through MCP tools, enabling developers to build and manage Vonage-powered applications. It is best suited for automating messaging workflows, managing application configurations, and sending notifications across multiple channels like SMS, WhatsApp, and RCS. Key capabilities include sending text messages via various platforms with optional failover, managing purchased phone numbers and application settings, checking account balance, and initiating outbound voice messages.

vscode-java.description: An MCP server that supports Java development in VS Code with debugging, code editing, and terminal command execution.
vscode-java.llm_summary: This MCP server enhances Java development in VS Code by integrating core IDE functionalities like debugging, code editing, and terminal operations directly into the MCP workflow. It is ideally suited for developers performing tasks such as writing and checking Java code, managing complex debugging sessions, and executing build or system commands without leaving their AI-assisted environment. wallet-mcp.description: An MCP server that enables wallet connectivity, balance checks, and transaction signing across multiple blockchain chains.
wallet-mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server provides blockchain wallet integration, allowing users to connect digital wallets, check cryptocurrency balances, and sign and send transactions across multiple supported chains. It is ideally suited for managing on-chain assets, executing token transfers, and interacting with decentralized applications directly through an AI assistant. Key capabilities include wallet connection management, real-time balance queries for any connected chain, and the secure signing and broadcasting of both native token transfers and generic transactions.

waroom mcp.description: A Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that enables interaction with Waroom API to retrieve incident information and postmortem details through a standardized protocol.
waroom mcp.llm_summary: This MCP server connects to the Waroom API to manage incident response and postmortem processes, allowing users to track, analyze, and document system outages and service issues. It is best suited for teams handling operational reliability, including incident commanders and engineers who need to log incidents, assess severity, and create postmortem reports. Key capabilities include retrieving active incidents and their details, updating incident status and labels, managing service metadata and architecture context, and creating structured postmortems with templates and associated metrics.

incident_uuids.description: List of incident UUIDs related to the postmortem.

vtex.description: An MCP server that enables commerce analytics and order management for VTEX stores through data retrieval and performance tracking tools.
vtex.llm_summary: This VTEX MCP server provides commerce analytics and order management for VTEX stores, enabling users to retrieve and analyze sales data and track store performance. It is best suited for tasks like reviewing order histories, monitoring conversion trends, and generating performance reports for business analysis. Key capabilities include searching and aggregating order data, breaking down metrics by categories or brands, and tracking conversion trends over time.

weather.description: The Weather MCP Server provides comprehensive weather data and forecasts for real-time integration into applications.
weather.llm_summary: This server provides weather data and forecasts for location-specific conditions, trip planning, event management, and hazardous-weather monitoring. Its observed tools cover current weather, daily and hourly forecasts, weather alerts, weather-station lookup, and local time.

wayback machine mcp server.description: Provides access to the Internet Archive Wayback Machine to list snapshots, fetch archived web pages, and search archive.org items. Enables retrieval of historical website content and metadata through natural language queries.
wayback machine mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables access to historical web content by interfacing with the Internet Archive's Wayback Machine, allowing users to retrieve archived versions of websites and their metadata. It is particularly useful for research, digital forensics, and content verification tasks that require viewing past states of web pages. Its key capabilities include fetching specific archived pages, listing available snapshots for a URL, and searching the broader Archive.org collection for items based on natural language queries.

weather data.description: An MCP server that provides current weather, multi-day forecast, location search, and a legacy live-temp endpoint via the WeatherAPI backend.
weather data.llm_summary: This server provides simple weather lookups oriented around city-level queries with tool names get_current_weather_tool, get_weather_forecast_tool, search_locations_tool, get_live_temp. It is best suited for agents that need to answer weather questions, plan trips, or display short-term forecasts. (Same Weather Data implementation as 'national-weather-service'; servers.json was previously misaligned with another weather variant.)

web inspector mcp.description: Enables AI assistants to inspect, debug, and test web pages using Playwright. Provides comprehensive DOM inspection, visibility debugging, layout validation, and element finding capabilities in real browser environments.
web inspector mcp.llm_summary: This server enables AI assistants to inspect, debug, and test live web pages within a real browser environment using Playwright. It is ideally suited for tasks like automated QA testing, debugging layout issues, verifying user interface behavior, and scraping dynamic web content. Its key capabilities include comprehensive DOM inspection, validating element visibility and alignment, interacting with pages via clicks and form fills, retrieving console logs and network requests, and finding elements by text or test IDs for robust automation.

webby mcp server.description: Provides comprehensive website validation across performance, accessibility, SEO, and security dimensions using multiple testing services including WebPageTest, Google PageSpeed Insights, Axe DevTools, Mozilla Observatory, and SSL Labs. Enables automated website health assessments through browser automation and API integrations.
webby mcp server.llm_summary: This MCP server performs automated, multi-dimensional website health assessments by integrating with specialized testing services like WebPageTest, Axe, and SSL Labs. It is ideally suited for developers and site auditors needing to validate a website's performance, accessibility, SEO, and security compliance in a single workflow. Its key capabilities include running comprehensive scans or targeted checks for specific areas, such as generating Lighthouse performance scores, detecting WCAG accessibility violations, and analyzing SSL certificate security.

web research assistant.description: Comprehensive web research toolkit with 13 tools for searching (via SearXNG), crawling, package discovery, GitHub metrics, error translation, API documentation lookup, data extraction, technology comparison, and service status checking.
web research assistant.llm_summary: This server provides a comprehensive web research toolkit that enables users to gather, analyze, and verify information from across the internet. It is ideally suited for developers, researchers, and technical analysts needing to perform tasks like competitive technology comparisons, debugging via error message translation, sourcing code examples, or investigating software packages and GitHub repositories. Its key capabilities include conducting web and image searches via SearXNG, crawling URLs for content extraction, checking API documentation and service statuses, and retrieving detailed package and repository metrics.

web scout mcp server.description: Enables privacy-focused web searches using DuckDuckGo and extraction of clean, readable content from web pages with support for parallel processing of multiple URLs.
web scout mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables privacy-focused web searches via DuckDuckGo and extracts clean, readable content from web pages, supporting parallel processing of multiple URLs. It is best suited for research tasks requiring private web exploration and efficient content gathering from multiple sources simultaneously. Key capabilities include performing web searches without tracking and extracting structured, readable text from web pages while handling multiple URLs in parallel for faster data collection.

It is ideally suited for research, fact-checking, content summarization, and exploring interconnected topics. Key capabilities include searching for articles, extracting full text or summaries, generating query-specific summaries, isolating key facts from sections, and discovering related topics and internal links within the encyclopedia.

whois mcp.description: Enables AI agents to perform WHOIS lookups to retrieve domain registration details, including ownership, registration dates, and availability status without requiring browser searches.
whois mcp.llm_summary: This server enables AI agents to perform WHOIS lookups to retrieve detailed domain registration information directly, eliminating the need for manual browser searches. It is best suited for tasks involving domain research, cybersecurity investigations, and verifying the availability or ownership status of web assets. Its key capabilities include looking up registration details for autonomous systems (AS), specific domains, IP addresses, and top-level domains (TLDs) to provide data on ownership, registration dates, and status.

windows-cli.description: An MCP server that enables Windows command line operations and SSH connection management for remote system administration.
windows-cli.llm_summary: This MCP server facilitates Windows system administration by enabling command line operations and SSH connection management for remote servers. It is best suited for automating administrative tasks, managing multiple remote systems, and executing batch commands across Windows environments. Key capabilities include creating and managing SSH connections, executing commands locally or remotely via SSH, retrieving command history, and navigating directories on Windows systems.

Key capabilities include secure JWT-authenticated content manipulation, comprehensive post search and retrieval, and support for the WordPress block editor through its schema tool.

web scraper mcp server.llm_summary: This server enables automated web data extraction, specializing in retrieving content from both static pages and dynamic single-page applications (SPAs). voicepeak mcp server.description: Enables text-to-speech synthesis using VOICEPEAK software with support for custom narrators, emotions, and pronunciation dictionaries. Allows generating and playing audio files from text with configurable voice parameters.

It is particularly well-suited for creating narrated content, audiobooks, or voiceovers where specific narrator personalities, emotional tones, and precise pronunciation control are required. fetchTokenPriceHistoryBySymbol.output_type: array of price data points with timestamp and price

e2b-server.description: An MCP server for E2B code sandbox that allows running Python code in a secure sandbox environment using Jupyter Notebook syntax.
e2b-server.llm_summary: This MCP server provides a secure sandbox for executing Python code using familiar Jupyter Notebook syntax, enabling safe and isolated code evaluation. It is best suited for developers and data scientists who need to run untrusted code snippets, test algorithms, or prototype data analysis in a contained environment. Its key capability is executing arbitrary Python code within the secure E2B sandbox via the run_code tool, preventing any risk to the host system.

run_code.description: Executes Python code in a secure E2B sandbox using Jupyter Notebook syntax.
run_code.input_type: Python code string, optional timeout, and optional environment variables
run_code.output_type: Execution result containing stdout, stderr, artifacts, and execution metadata

google-workspace.description: An MCP server for Google Workspace that provides tools to list upcoming calendar events from Google Calendar.
google-workspace.llm_summary: This MCP server provides access to Google Calendar data within Google Workspace, specifically designed to retrieve a user's scheduled events. It is best suited for tasks that require checking availability, reviewing daily agendas, or integrating calendar information into other workflows. Its key capability is listing upcoming calendar events, allowing users to query their schedule directly.

list_events.description: Retrieve upcoming events from Google Calendar
list_events.input_type: optional max results count and time range parameters
list_events.output_type: list of calendar event objects with details like summary, start time, and attendees

lara-translate.description: An MCP server for Lara Translate that provides text translation between languages with support for language detection and context-aware translations.
lara-translate.llm_summary: The Lara Translate MCP server provides text translation services, enabling conversion between a wide range of languages with additional support for automatic language detection and context-aware output. It is best suited for tasks requiring multilingual text processing, such as translating documents, localizing content, or understanding foreign language text within a given context. Its key capabilities include performing direct translations using the translate tool and retrieving the full list of supported languages via list_languages for informed language selection.

translate.description: Translate text between languages with support for language detection, context-aware translations, and translation memories.
translate.input_type: source text, target language, optional source language and context parameters
translate.output_type: translated text with optional metadata like detected language and confidence scores

list_languages.description: Lists all supported languages in your Lara Translate account.
list_languages.output_type: list of supported language objects with codes and names

pubmed.description: An MCP server for PubMed that provides tools to search biomedical literature by keywords or advanced queries, retrieve article metadata, and download PDFs.
pubmed.llm_summary: This MCP server provides direct access to PubMed's vast biomedical literature database, enabling users to search for scientific articles and retrieve detailed publication information. It is best suited for researchers, students, and medical professionals who need to conduct literature reviews, gather citations, or access full-text research papers. Its key capabilities include performing both simple keyword and advanced structured searches, fetching comprehensive article metadata, and downloading PDFs of available publications.

search_pubmed_key_words.description: Search PubMed articles using keyword queries
search_pubmed_key_words.input_type: search query string, optional result limit and date range filters
search_pubmed_key_words.output_type: list of article metadata objects with IDs, titles, authors, and publication details

search_pubmed_advanced.description: Search biomedical literature using advanced query parameters such as keywords, authors, publication dates, and journal names.
search_pubmed_advanced.input_type: advanced query parameters including keywords, authors, publication dates, journal names, and result limits
search_pubmed_advanced.output_type: list of article metadata objects with identifiers, titles, authors, abstracts, and publication details

get_pubmed_article_metadata.description: Retrieves detailed metadata for a specific PubMed article by its ID.
get_pubmed_article_metadata.output_type: structured article metadata including title, authors, abstract, and journal details

download_pubmed_pdf.description: Download a PDF file for a specified PubMed article using its PubMed ID (PMID).

Pokémon MCP Server.description: Enables users to retrieve Pokémon statistics, sprite images, and complete information using the PokeAPI. Supports querying by Pokémon name or ID number to get base stats, various sprite URLs including shiny variants, and comprehensive Pokémon data.
Pokémon MCP Server.llm_summary: This MCP server provides access to comprehensive Pokémon data by leveraging the PokeAPI, enabling users to retrieve detailed statistics, sprite images, and complete information about any Pokémon. It is ideal for tasks like building Pokémon databases, creating visual references, or analyzing game mechanics by querying specific Pokémon by name or ID number. Key capabilities include fetching base stats, obtaining various sprite URLs (including shiny variants), and accessing complete Pokémon data through its dedicated tools.

fetch-pokemon.description: Fetches a specific Pokémon by name from the server.

pokemon.description: The name of the Pokémon to fetch.

get-current-pokemon.description: Retrieves the currently active Pokémon from the server.

Pokémon VGC Damage Calculator MCP Server.description: An MCP-compliant server that enables AI agents to perform accurate Pokémon battle damage calculations using the Smogon calculator, supporting comprehensive input handling for Pokémon stats, moves, abilities, and field conditions.
Pokémon VGC Damage Calculator MCP Server.llm_summary: This server provides precise Pokémon battle damage calculations by integrating with the Smogon calculator engine, allowing AI agents to simulate turn outcomes. It is ideally suited for analyzing competitive VGC (Video Game Championships) scenarios, team building, and move selection strategies. Its key capability is the `calculateDamage` tool, which processes comprehensive inputs including specific Pokémon stats, moves, abilities, items, and detailed field conditions to deliver accurate damage ranges and potential knock-out probabilities.

calculateDamage.description: Calculates Pokémon VGC battle damage based on attacker, defender, move, and field parameters.

species.description: Name of the attacking Pokémon species

item.description: Held item of the attacking Pokémon

status.description: Current status condition (e.g. burned, paralyzed)

species.description: Name of the defending Pokémon species

item.description: Held item of the defending Pokémon

status.description: Current status condition (e.g. burned, paralyzed)

name.description: Name of the move being used

isCrit.description: Whether the attack is a critical hit

filesystem-mcp-server.description: Official MCP filesystem server (`@modelcontextprotocol/server-filesystem`). Provides safe read/write/edit/list/search/move operations restricted to a list of allowed root directories.
filesystem-mcp-server.llm_summary: This is the official Model Context Protocol filesystem server. It enables an AI agent to perform local file system operations on a sandbox of pre-approved root directories: read full files (text or binary base64), write or overwrite files, perform line-based edits with a diff preview, create directories, list directory contents, get a recursive directory tree, move/rename files, search for files by glob pattern, retrieve file metadata, and list which roots are allowed. Best suited for tasks that require an LLM to inspect, modify, or organize files on the local filesystem within a sandboxed scope.

read_file.description: Read the complete contents of a single text file from the filesystem. Returns the file content as UTF-8 text. Errors out for binary files unless an explicit content head is requested.

read_text_file.description: Read the complete contents of a file from the filesystem as text. Handles various text encodings. Preferred over read_file (which is deprecated).
read_text_file.input_type: file path (string), optional tail (int, last N lines), optional head (int, first N lines)

read_media_file.description: Read an image or other media file and return it as a base64-encoded data URI. Use for binary/image files that read_text_file cannot handle.

read_multiple_files.description: Read the complete contents of multiple files in a single call. Failures on individual files do not stop the others.
read_multiple_files.output_type: for each path, file contents or per-file error message

write_file.description: Create a new file or completely overwrite an existing file with the given content. Use this to produce new files; for in-place modifications prefer `edit_file`.
write_file.input_type: file path (string) and full file content (string)

edit_file.description: Perform line-based edits on an existing text file using a list of {oldText, newText} replacement pairs. Returns a unified-diff preview of the changes; supports a dry-run mode that previews without writing.
edit_file.input_type: file path, list of {oldText, newText} edits, optional dryRun flag
edit_file.output_type: unified diff of applied or proposed edits

create_directory.description: Create a new directory (parents created as needed). Idempotent: succeeds if the directory already exists.

list_directory.description: List the immediate contents of a directory, marking each entry as [FILE] or [DIR].
list_directory.output_type: list of entries with type prefix

list_directory_with_sizes.description: List the immediate contents of a directory with file sizes. Entries can be sorted by name or size.
list_directory_with_sizes.output_type: list of entries with type prefix and file size

directory_tree.description: Get a recursive JSON tree view of all files and subdirectories below the given path.

move_file.description: Move or rename a file or directory. Source and destination must both lie inside an allowed root directory.

search_files.description: Recursively search for files whose names match a pattern (case-insensitive substring or glob), starting from a given directory. Supports an exclude list.
search_files.input_type: root path, pattern, optional list of exclude patterns
search_files.output_type: list of matching absolute file paths

get_file_info.description: Retrieve detailed metadata for a single file or directory, including size, creation/modification time, and permissions.
get_file_info.output_type: metadata object with size, mtime, ctime, isDirectory, isFile, permissions

list_allowed_directories.description: List the root directories the server is allowed to access. Useful at session start to discover the sandbox scope.
list_allowed_directories.output_type: list of absolute root directory paths

mongodb.description: An MCP server that exposes a read-oriented MongoDB toolset for inspecting databases, collections, schemas, indexes, and running find/aggregate queries.
mongodb.llm_summary: This server provides programmatic access to a MongoDB deployment with a focus on database introspection and query execution. It is best suited for analytics, data exploration, schema discovery, and read-mostly admin workflows. Key capabilities include listing databases and collections, describing collection schemas and indexes, running find/aggregate/count queries, retrieving collection storage size and database statistics, and explaining query plans.

list-collections.description: List all collections for a given database

list-databases.description: List all databases for a MongoDB connection

collection-schema.description: Describe the schema for a collection

find.description: Run a find query against a MongoDB collection

collection-indexes.description: Describe the indexes for a collection

collection-storage-size.description: Gets the size of the collection

count.description: Gets the number of documents in a MongoDB collection using db.collection.count() and query as an optional filter parameter

db-stats.description: Returns statistics that reflect the use state of a single database

aggregate.description: Run an aggregation against a MongoDB collection

explain.description: Returns statistics describing the execution of the winning plan chosen by the query optimizer for the evaluated method

nasa data.description: An MCP server that exposes NASA's open data APIs, including astronomy picture of the day, near-earth asteroid feeds, DONKI space-weather events, Earth and EPIC satellite imagery, exoplanet archive, and Mars rover photos.
nasa data.llm_summary: This server provides unified access to a wide range of NASA open-data services. It is ideally suited for astronomy and space-weather research, Earth observation queries, and content generation that needs official NASA imagery or datasets. Key capabilities include retrieving the daily astronomy picture, browsing and looking up near-earth asteroids, querying coronal mass ejection / geomagnetic storm / solar flare / SEP / MPC / RBE / HSS / WSA-Enlil records, fetching Earth and EPIC imagery, querying NASA's exoplanet archive, and accessing Mars rover photos and mission manifests.

get_astronomy_picture_of_day.description: Get NASA's astronomy picture of the day.

get_asteroids_feed.description: Get a list of asteroids based on their closest approach date to Earth.

get_asteroid_lookup.description: Look up a specific asteroid based on its NASA JPL ID.

get_earth_imagery.description: Get Earth imagery from Landsat 8 satellite.

get_earth_assets.description: Get information about available imagery assets for a specific location and date.

get_epic_imagery.description: Get images from the EPIC (Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera).

get_epic_imagery_by_date.description: Get images from the EPIC (Earth Polychromatic Imaging Camera) for a specific date.

get_epic_dates.description: Get available dates for EPIC images.

get_exoplanet_data.description: Get data from NASA's Exoplanet Archive.

get_mars_rover_photos.description: Get photos from a Mars rover (Curiosity, Opportunity, Spirit).

get_mars_rover_manifest.description: Get the mission manifest for a Mars rover (Curiosity, Opportunity, Spirit).

national-weather-service.description: An MCP server that surfaces real-time and forecast weather data for cities worldwide, including current conditions, multi-day forecasts, location lookup, and a legacy live-temperature endpoint.
national-weather-service.llm_summary: This server provides simple weather lookups oriented around city-level queries. It is well suited for assistants that need to answer weather questions, plan trips, or display short-term forecasts. Key capabilities include retrieving current weather conditions for a city, fetching weather forecasts, searching cities by name to resolve ambiguities, and a legacy endpoint that returns just the current temperature.

get_current_weather_tool.description: Get current weather information for a specific city.

get_weather_forecast_tool.description: Get weather forecast for a specific city.

get_live_temp.description: Legacy tool: Get current temperature for a city (for backward compatibility).

mongodb-crypto.description: An MCP server that provides cryptocurrency market data such as live coin prices and asset listings, distinct from the official MongoDB MCP server that shares the bare name 'mongodb' in some catalogs.
mongodb-crypto.llm_summary: This server exposes lightweight cryptocurrency lookup tools, primarily intended for assistants that need quick coin prices, bitcoin spot quotes, or a list of supported tradable assets. It is suited for FinOps demos and chat assistants that answer crypto questions in real time. Key capabilities include retrieving the current bitcoin price, fetching the latest price of a named cryptocurrency, and listing available assets.

slack-bot.description: An MCP server that exposes the Slack Bot API surface using slack_-prefixed tools for posting messages, reading channels, replying to threads, and adding reactions.
slack-bot.llm_summary: This server is a bot-style Slack integration with a verb-oriented tool naming scheme (slack_post_message, slack_get_users, etc). It is best suited for chat agents that need to send messages, fetch channel/user info, react with emoji, and traverse threads in a Slack workspace, in contrast to the more API-oriented 'slack' server that surfaces raw conversations endpoints.

memory-aim.description: An MCP server that provides a knowledge-graph memory store with aim_-prefixed tools for managing entities, relations, observations, and multiple databases.
memory-aim.llm_summary: This server is the AIM (multi-database) variant of the memory MCP server. It supports the same knowledge-graph operations (entities, relations, observations, search/read) but additionally allows agents to list and switch between multiple memory databases. Suited for agents that maintain long-term episodic memory across separated contexts.

huggingface-hub-search-alt.description: An MCP server providing Hugging Face Hub search and metadata access using underscore-style tool names (get_model_info, find_similar_models, etc).
huggingface-hub-search-alt.llm_summary: This server exposes Hugging Face Hub search and similarity tools. Beyond the dash-style 'huggingface-hub-search' variant it adds capabilities like find_similar_models / find_similar_datasets, get_model_safetensors_metadata, and downloading model/dataset cards. Suited for agents that browse, compare, and download HF artifacts.

mcp-google-maps-alt.description: An MCP server providing Google Maps services with verb-oriented tool naming (get_directions, search_nearby, get_place_details, get_map_with_directions, etc).
mcp-google-maps-alt.llm_summary: This server provides geocoding, routing, distance matrix, elevation, place details, nearby search, and a tool to render a static map with overlaid directions. The naming style differs from 'mcp google maps' which uses the maps_ prefix. Suited for agents that need both data lookups and a quick visual artifact.

national-weather-service-alt.description: An MCP server that surfaces weather queries (current, forecast, hourly, alerts, station search, local time) using non-suffixed tool names, as a parallel to the get_*_tool variant used by mcpbench's 'Weather Data' / 'national-weather-service'.
national-weather-service-alt.llm_summary: This server exposes a richer set of weather endpoints than the get_*_tool variant: get_current_weather, get_weather_forecast, get_hourly_forecast, get_weather_alerts, find_weather_stations, get_local_time. Suited for agents needing detailed forecasts, station lookups, or local-time helpers in addition to current conditions.
